caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The object appears to be a folded piece of fabric, possibly linen or cotton, rendered in shades of cream and pale beige. It is primarily rectangular in shape, with the upper edge forming a pointed arch. The top section features an ornate, scalloped lace trim decorated with small, detailed floral patterns, drawn in white and soft gray tones. The body of the fabric is mostly plain, but subtle shading and lines indicate gentle folds and creases. The edges of the piece display a slightly darker hue, adding depth to the depiction. The entire composition is minimalistic, with no other objects or patterns present in the background.
title: Handkerchief
